arabic text: KEHTI THI YE MAA KHOON BHARI MAIYAT SAY LIPAT KAR\nHAYE HAYE ALI AKBAR, HAYE HAYE ALI AKBAR.
english translation text: HIS MOTHER KEPT SAYING WHILE ATTACHED TO THE BODY SOAKED IN BLOOD\nO MY ALI AKBAR, O MY ALI AKBAR.

arabic text: ARMAN THA PEHNAWOON GI POSHAK SHAHANI\nAFSOOS KE RAAS AAYI NA TUJH KU YEH JAWANI\nKAISA THA MUQADDAR, HAYE HAYE ALI AKBAR.
english translation text: I HAD A WISH TO DRESS YOU IN A GRAND MANNER\nBUT SADLY YOUR YOUTH WAS SNATCHED AWAY FROM YOU\nALAS! WHAT A DESTINY, O MY ALI AKBAR

arabic text: AUR GAISUWOON WALA HAI MERA KHOO(N) MAIN NAHAYA\nKURBAN HO MAADAR, HAYE HAYE ALI AKBAR.
english translation text:
ATHARA BARAS PAAL KAY PARWAN CHARHAYA
EIGHTEEN YEARS DID I NURTURE AND RAISED YOU
YET MY YOUNG LAD, WITH HANDSOME LOCKS OF HAIR, IS BATHED IN BLOOD
MAY YOUR MOTHER BE SACRIFICED FOR YOU, O ALI AKBAR

arabic text: BAS EK JHALAK SEHRAY KI SUGHRA KO DHIKA LOON\nBAICHAIN THI KHWAHAR, HAYE HAYE ALI AKBAR.\nITNA TO ZARA THEHRO TUMHAI DHULHA BANA LOON
english translation text: PLEASE WAIT FOR SOMETIME SO THAT I CAN SEE YOU AS A GROOM\nALLOW ME TO SHOW SUGHRA A GLIMPSE OF YOU.\nYOUR SISTER IS WORRIED, O MY ALI AKBAR

arabic text: MAA TERI JUDAYI MEIN BHALA KAISAY JEEYE GI\nMAR JAAYEGI SUGHRA JO KHABAR TERI SUNAY GI\nAB KYA KAROON DILBER, HAYE HAYE ALI AKBAR.
english translation text: HOW WILL YOUR MUM SURVIVE WHEN YOU ARE GONE\nSUGHRA WILL DIE WHEN SHE HEARS THIS NEWS\nWHAT I SHOULD DO MY SWEET HEART, O MY ALI AKBAR

arabic text: TEHRO KAY MEIN ATHARWEEN MANNAT TO BADHA LOON\nPHIR LAY KAY BALAYEIN TUJHAY JEENAY KI DUA DOON\nSADQAY HO AY MAADAR, HAYE HAYE ALI AKBAR
english translation text: WAIT TILL I FULFILL MY EIGHTEENTH PROMISE\nI SHALL TAKE ALL YOUR TRIBULATIONS AND PRAY FOR YOUR LIFE\nMAY YOUR MOM BE SACRIFICED FOR YOU, O MY ALI AKBAR

arabic text: PEHLAY TO EK AAWAZ PAY UTH JATAY THAY BETA\nAB ETNI SAADA’OON PAY BHI PEHLOO NAHI BADLA\nKYA HO GAYA DILBER, HAYE HAYE ALI AKBAR.
english translation text: EARLIER, YOU WOULD WAKE UP AS SOON AS YOU WOULD HEAR ME\nWHEREAS NOW, DESPITE CALLING YOU NUMEROUS TIMES, YOU ARE NOT RESPONDING\nWHAT HAPPENED TO YOU O MY SWEET HEART, O MY ALI AKBAR

arabic text: TUM HICHKIYAAN LAY LAY KAY JO DAM TAUR RAHAY HO\nMOO MAA SAY HAMAISHA KAY LIYE MOUR RAHAY HO\nKYON ROOTAY HO DILBER, HAYE HAYE ALI AKBAR
english translation text: WHILST YOU BREATHE YOUR LAST BREATH AND HICCUP (FROM THIRST) AT THE SAME TIME,\nYOU ARE DEPARTING FROM YOUR MOTHER FOREVER,\nWHY DO YOU CRY O MY SWEET HEART, HAYE HAYE ALI AKBAR

arabic text: AAYE JO HAMEIN LOOTNAY KHAIMAY MEIN SITAMGAR\nMAA DAY GI SADAAYEIN ALI AKBAR, ALI AKBAR\nCHIN JAAYAY GI CHAADAR, HAYE HAYE ALI AKBAR.
english translation text: WHEN THE ENEMIES COME TO TAKE OUR BELONGINGS FROM THE TENT\nYOUR MOTHER WILL CALL OUT SAYING O MY ALI AKBAR, O MY ALI AKBAR\nMY VEILS WILL BE SNATCHED AWAY, O MY ALI AKBAR

arabic text: JAB KOI JAWAN LAASH NAZAR AATI HAI MAHSHAR\nEK YAAD SUWAY KARBOBALA JAATI HAI MAHSHAR\nDIL ROTA HAY KEH KAR, HAYE HAYE ALI AKBAR
english translation text: WHENEVER I SEE ANY YOUNG PERSON’S DEAD BODY\nMY THOUGHTS REACH OUT TO KARBALA\nMY HEART CRIES FOR YOU,O MY ALI AKBAR

arabic text: KEHTI THI YEH MAA KHOON BHARI MAYYAT SE LIPAT KAR
english translation text: THE MOTHER OF ALI AKBER (A.S) LAMENTED AT HIS BODY COVERED WITH BLOOD!

arabic text: ITNA TO ZARA TEHRO TUMHEIN DULHA BANALOON\nBAS EK JHALAK SEHRE KI SUGHRA KO DHIKALOON\nBECHAIN THI QAAHAR HAAY HAAY ALI AKBAR
english translation text:
OH ALI AKBAR! OH ALI AKBAR!
AT LEAST WAIT SO I CAN DRESS YOU AS A GROOM,
SO I MAY SHOW YOUR SISTER A GLANCE OF YOU ALL ADORNED,
YOUR SISTER IS RESTLESS FOR THIS.

arabic text: ATTHARA BARAS PAAL KE PARWAAN CHADAYA\nWO GAYSUWON WALA HAI MERA KHOON MAY NAHAAYA\nYE KYA HUA DILBAR HAAY HAAY ALI AKBAR
english translation text:
OH ALI AKBAR! OH ALI AKBAR!
I BROUGHT YOU UP FOR 18 YEARS INTO THE PRIME OF YOUTH
AND NOW YOU ARE BATHED IN BLOOD,
WHAT IS THE POINT OF MY EXISTENCE FROM NOW ON?
